name: figma-design-workflow
description: Figma and FigJam editor workflows, editable Stitch imports, visual references, and evidence-based visual QA.

interface.shortDescription: From visual direction to verified Figma designs
interface.longDescription: Four focused skills: operate Figma and editable FigJam workshop boards with current editor evidence; transfer Stitch screens into editable layers; prepare Claude/imagegen references; and review visible usability, native structure, and craft. Uses available tools without adding background services.
defaultPrompt: Prepare visual references or import Stitch screens into editable Figma layers.
Review these Figma screens and fix the key visual issues.
Build an editable FigJam workshop board and verify its editor behavior.
